1.description: [Original 9 Classes] Fixed an issue where the some heals used by the 9 classes did not have the correct coefficient. (This results in a healing nerf for some abilities and a buff for others, but overall shouldn't be a net loss in healing.)
Pushed a fix that should prevent Ragefire Nova from dealing friendly fire in rare circumstances. (Pending Restart)
[Pending restart] Fixed an issue where Gloomblade did not benefit from the effects of Agile Strikes (Agility allocation bonus).

6.description: [Dungeon Spoils 60] Fixed an issue where Dungeon Spoils at level 60 for normal and heroic did not correctly have a tank equipment option to select.
[Pending Restart] [Dead Mines] Edwin VanCleef - moved the periodic summon of blackguards to mythic difficulty. On normal and heroic he will summon blackguards only at 75%, 50%, 25% health remaining.

0.description: [Pending Restart] Classes will now have a more similar base health curve as classless during leveling. (Base health at 60 is virtually the same.)
[Archimonde] You now gain 100% more arena points from playing arena.
[Pending Restart] - Reduced the health of Monsters and Bosses in Mythic0 by 10% (Archimonde)
Fixed an issue where the heal from Unbounded Deathbringer would scale with your attack and spell power.
[Archimonde] You now take 10% reduced damage taken in arena.
[Build Draft] Bulwark will now learn the Legendary Enchant much earlier.
[Archimonde] Orgrimmar and Stormwind Guards will now provide directions to Build and Trial Vendors that can be find in their respective cities.

[Build Draft] Elemental Blade: Added early level mana talents. Added Rare Mystic Enchants to add power and resource management for early levels to account for Epic and Legendary Enchants relying on spells with high level requirements.

[Build Draft] Beast and Blade: Shifted Enchant level learns to give the Legendary earlier. Added an early level heal. Added Precision and Improved Mend Pet Rare Enchants to help with early game flow and mana management. Added improved Sinister Strike to early levels.
[Build Draft] Divine Beast: Set the Legendary and Epic enchants to be learned earlier. Added Anger Management Rare Enchants for rage management.
[Build Draft] Light's blade: Swapped Judgements of the Pure for Judgements of the Wise in the 60 PvE build to alleviate mana issues.

[Pending Restart] - Buildmaster Trophies have been sent out to the original 9 classes if they had levelled to level 60! This process is now automated upon hitting level 60, rewarding you a build master trophy for the first time you hit level 60 with an original class.
Warrior's Defensive Stance, Taunt and Sunder Armor are now taught via the book of ascension and warrior trainers.
Players will now put into PVE mode by default when creating a character and hitting 15 until they opt into Highrisk PvP or No Risk PvP

You can now gain experience from professions even when you are skillcapped as long as you are not at a level that you can unlock the next profession tier. This should help smooth out some friction in crafting trials and while leveling.
Fixed an issue where some damage calculations (mostly dots, pets, absorbs and some fringe spell cases) where over-capping your PvE or PvP power would still increase your damage for those spells.
Added a scroll bar for challenge restrictions, because trial architects keep adding 10000 restrictions to custom trials.
Improved handling for PVE mode. It should be much less likely to fall off when it shouldn't.
Added a system that will teleport hardcore players to a safe zone after a server restart or server crash to prevent uncanny deaths due to these scenarios.
Illusionary Imps will now fixate on their current target and despawn if they lose aggro.
Improved Legion Invasion boss AI to put caps on summoned creatures to prevent performance issues.
Improved Invasion Gargoyle AI they will no longer fly as high and will grab players less frequently.
Redistributed PVE/PvP Power on gear to be more weighted towards weapons. This means weapons will have more PVE/PvP power and other slots will have less.
Cleaned up Build draft and featured build text to clarify their differences.
Improved some edge cases where Build Drafts would fail to unlock enchants when hitting 60.
Fixed various issues that could cause Invasions to get stuck.
Increased Healing and Damage Taken contribution during invasions by 25%
[Pending Restart] - [Original 9 Classes] - Fixed an issue where Ferals were not learning Feline Grace at level 4.
[Original 9 Classes] - Fixed an issue where Shamans were not learning call of the (elements, spirits, etc).
[Build Draft] Nature's Prayer: Replaced Brilliance Aura with Life Tap. Added early game Rare Mystic Enchants to account for the Epic and Legendary Enchants requiring higher level spells to unlock.
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where the original versions of the class spells and the classless hero spells would stack with each other.

[Build Draft] Grove Warden: Added early game power with Rare Mystic Enchants to account for the build's epic and legendary enchants requiring higher level spells. Shifted some talents around to make the overall flow smoother.
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where talents that affected your chance to hit with spells and abilities was not visually increased via your character panel.
[Pending Restart] - [Original 9 Classes] - Corrected an issue where Mind Flay had an incorrect Spell Power scalin

[Pending Restart] - [Original 9 Classes] - Fixed an issue where Conflagrate, Chimaera Shot and Seal of Command were "double dipping" on modifiers. The damage for the respective specializations has been increased to supplement the bugfix and try to retain their viability at endgame only.

Fixed an issue where Cauterizing Flames could proc the Fire Fire Fireball buff without having the enchant active, causing the cast speed reduction debuff to get stuck.
[Faith Rekindled] Fixed an issue where it was not correctly triggering on allies.

[Charged Tides] Fixed an issue where when used in conjunction with Tree of Wrath sometimes you would eat a Charged Tides stack that was generated instantly. Resulting in lost value from this Epic Mystic Enchantment.
[Archimonde] Fixed an issue where Flame Burst from Harbinger of Flame did not have its PvP mod applied. It now deals 50% reduced damage to players.
[Requires Launcher Update] Fixed an issue where Circle of Life, Natural Zeal, Momentum and Chaos Burn Mystic Enchants would not be visible.

Fixed an issue in invasions where Wail of Weakness would target all players and creatures in the entire zone. It will now only target players within 40 yards.

Priest Class: Temporarily disabled Shadow Word: Death while we resolve a bug causing it to one shot the caster. While thematic to the name, this was not great gameplay.
Fixed an issue where Demon Armor could not always be learned from Book of Ascension.

Hurricane Strike now deals 20% reduced damage versus players.
